facts.fact: AidData record of the China Eximbank loan states the Ceiba-2 cable, a 400 km submarine system owned and operated by GITGE connecting Malabo and Bata with a branching unit to Kribi in Cameroon, was built under the loan (status Completed, end year 2017).

The same record states the Ceiba-2 and ACE submarine stations in Bata sit next to each other and are directly fibre-linked, so GNQ has both ACE and Ceiba-2 at Bata; same station, so two not independent.

note: Loan record; in-service date inferred from status Completed and end year 2017.
